title: Union Cabinet Approves 'Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS)' with ₹62,500 Crore Outlay
summary: 5-year scheme (FY27 to FY31) targeting ₹39 lakh crore mobile production and 60,000 direct jobs.

blocks.content: 5-year scheme (FY27 to FY31) targeting ₹39 lakh crore mobile production and 60,000 direct jobs.

items: Scheme Outlay & Tenure: ₹62,500 crore budget outlay running for 5 years from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31.
Incentive Tiers: Differentiated sales incentives of 2.25% to 5%; additional 1.5% incentive for domestic component sourcing; 3% incentive for product design R&D.
Electronics Export Milestone: Smartphones emerged as India's single largest exported product category in 2025 (99.2% of domestic phones built in India).

blocks.summary: MPMS succeeds PLI Scheme for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing (PLI-LSEM) which concluded March 2026.
